title: Diary of Merer records Tura limestone being shipped to the 'horizon of Khufu'

tellings.quote: And we have a we have a ledger of those being brought up to Giza. It's it's called the diary of Morer. Um and and he says that he's bringing these Tur limestone blocks up to the horizon of Kufu.

plain: An ancient Egyptian logbook called the Diary of Merer, kept by an official named Merer, records shipments of limestone blocks from the quarries at Tura up to Giza, to what it calls 'the horizon of Khufu', the pharaoh's pyramid. The researcher Luke Caverns raises it on the show as 'a ledger' of the stones being brought up to Giza. In his reading, it records the stone being delivered for the pyramid. What it leaves open is how much of the building, beyond these deliveries, the logbook can account for.
